description: This is a JavaScript source file defining a UI component named 'EditorPanel' using a Lightning.js-like framework. It manages note editing functionalities such as editing title and content, saving, deleting, and regenerating summaries, along with internal state and event handling.

classes.name: EditorPanel
classes.description: A Lightning.js component for editing and viewing notes, including features such as editing title/content, saving, deleting, and summary regeneration.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with the currently selected note from the store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current title and content to the store for the selected note.

methods.name: regenerateSummary
methods.description: Generates a new summary based on the current content, updating the store.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note from the store.

methods.name: editTitle
methods.description: Sets the component to title editing mode.

methods.name: editContent
methods.description: Sets the component to content editing mode.

methods.name: _startCursorBlink
methods.description: Starts blinking cursor animation in the input fields.

methods.name: _handleBackspace
methods.description: Handles backspace key press in editing.

methods.name: _handleNewline
methods.description: Handles newline (Enter key) in content editing.
